# Ninai

Ninai gives supported assistants permissioned project memory. Local setup keeps memory on the user's Mac. A separate hosted workspace is available for invited testing; it does not automatically upload or synchronize local memory.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://ninai.io/
- Install: https://ninai.io/install/
- Local engine: https://ninai.io/local/
- Privacy: https://ninai.io/privacy/

## Core product facts
- Local mode stores memory in SQLite on the user's computer. Hosted mode stores submitted memory in a separate online workspace.
- Supported local assistants connect through a local tool interface. Hosted assistants use an authenticated online connection.
- Each assistant receives only the memory areas the user allows.
- Returned context includes its source and a bounded amount of text.
- In local mode, the complete memory stays on the device, but selected context is sent to the chosen AI provider. Hosted memory is stored online.
- Automatic capture currently targets Claude Code PostToolUse hooks.
- Hosted setup is for invited testing. Private Codex and ChatGPT flows have verified project access, proposal review, source-backed recall, and revocation. This is not a public directory release or universal host-compatibility claim.
- Connecting Ninai does not give it silent access to unrelated ChatGPT or Claude conversations.
- Local memory is never uploaded or synchronized automatically.
- Ninai has not completed an independent security audit and does not yet ship a signed desktop package.
- Use the same account and sign-in method in the dashboard and assistant. Google sign-in and email/password may be separate identities.
- Cloud Reconnect restores a saved connection without restoring old project permissions. Explicitly grant access again and test recall.
